newsitem.title: GERMANY: German Weru sees 1996 profit above forecast.
newsitem.headline: German Weru sees 1996 profit above forecast.

text.p: German window and door manufacturer Weru AG said on Tuesday its preliminary 1996 figures showed it had exceeded its original forecast of operating profit of something over 30 million marks ($19 million).

Speaking before the BAU 97 trade fair in Munich, chairman Juergen Bockstette also said the group expected net turnover for the year of around 450 million marks compared to 500.6 million marks the year before.
Weru, a majority-owned unit of Britain's Caradon Plc , said it expected 1997 turnover and unit sales to be around the same level of 1996. ($1=1.5867 Mark)
